authored_by: the team, labelling its own synthetic data
source_of_truth: 02_src/adii/examples/canonical_world.py: the world was generated knowing what happened in it; a development key, never an unseen one
freeze_note: Frozen on authoring, 23 Sep 2026, before any run against it. A correction is a new key, never an edit.
purpose: The development set's label for this generated incident.
root_cause_explanation: The vendor delivered all 80 orders for 2026-07-07 (raw_orders, the vendor receipt and the manifest agree), but the load committed only 24 (load_log: FAILED, rows_loaded 24). stg_orders stages a batch only up to the loader's acknowledged line, so the rest never reached the mart. The release that morning is unrelated.

repair_must_satisfy.description: Stage every delivered order exactly once, so the mart counts all of the day's orders; change nothing else.
repair_must_satisfy.reference_patch_effect: stg_orders selects every row of raw_orders, without the loader-acknowledged limit
alternative_repairs_are_acceptable_if: every order in raw_orders appears in stg_orders exactly once
daily revenue equals the delivered orders' amounts, day by day
no amount is scaled, estimated or copied from another day
repair_must_satisfy.validation_requirement: REPAIR is only correct if the validator accepts it.

why_not_no_repair: The mart is wrong relative to its own source: orders that arrived are missing from it.
why_not_escalate: Every decisive fact is reachable, and the delivered orders are in the world, so the repair can be made and checked.
